content: Kate Compton 10k bowls of oatmeal: mathematical uniqueness is not perceptual uniqueness. Tanya Short: newbies fear chaos, should fear blandness. Into the Breach authored map layouts then randomized only non-critical dress. Level Design Book: landmarks need local contrast; density clutter hides hierarchy; always-on HUD/minimap is 97 percent certainty and hides whether the world itself wayfinds. Hybrid: hand-author places, keep PCG for filler only.
